context_compaction.evidence_quote: Per-tool line caps (bash 80 · read 300 · grep 120), ANSI strip, blank-line collapse, semantic JSON/XML extraction.
context_compaction.note: `/compact` manual compaction and packages/ai/src/cache/compaction.ts give summarize.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Claude Desktop now sees Caveman Code's coding tools (Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write).

tool_count.evidence_quote: Claude Desktop now sees Caveman Code's coding tools (Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Edit, Write).
tool_count.note: Count from the MCP-server tool listing; Task/memory_search/memory_save also exist, so the real default count is higher.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: caveman mcp-server # run caveman itself as an MCP server (Codex-compatible)

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Autonomous goal loop — Ralph-style autopilot. Rolling state, per-iteration $/token ledger, shadow-git checkpoints, ranked termination
loop_primitives.note: Default interactive mode is react; /plan then /act gives plan_execute; goal loop iterates.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Plan mode — read-only chat. Model sees only `read`/`grep`/`find`/`ls`, produces a written plan, never edits. Subagents inherit the gate. `/act` to execute.
planning_granularity.note: Plan is saved and executed via /act; plan mode is opt-in.

multi_agent_topology.note: Single agent by default; orchestrator_workers reachable via the Task tool.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Subagents — up to 7 parallel, worktree-isolated. Frontmatter agents at `.cave/agents/*.md` (Claude Code superset). Five ship by default.
delegation_mechanism.note: Task tool spawns subagents; five agent definitions ship by default.
